data.algorithm: Existing input-only per-channel CFA least squares, all101995852 measured samples, no masks/gain bounds/clamps/shrinkage/reference inputs. analytical_noisy_fit_counterexample.scope: Analytical scalar Gaussian counterexample to treating noisy-input gain fitting as universally correct; not a camera denoising benchmark or diagnosis of the GFX cause.
analytical_noisy_fit_counterexample.proof: For p=k*y and any nonzero observations, sum(p*y)/sum(p*p)=1/k; corrected output is y. This undoes the optimal Gaussian posterior shrinkage. A fit against a noisy observation can therefore worsen denoising despite no GT access. It does not prove this is the mechanism in the nonlinear GFX model.
